snippet.title: [Maimaimaigoen] Game Episode 6, Part 1 (English Subs)
snippet.description:
Translations by Ganbarebenji and Anonymous Piyo ( https://twitter.com/artwaltzed )
Turn on English subtitles by clicking the CC icon at the bottom of the video.

Our translation of Episode 6 is finally here! Thank you for waiting, demi!

The episode title seems to be a play on the word "hiiro." When written as "緋色," it translates to "red," whereas "ヒーロー" means "hero." Typically, the word "赤い (akai)" would be used to describe something red in color, so the choice of using the hiragana "ひいろ" seems intentional because it could be interpreted as either. 

The reason why we chose "red" over "hero" is because, if they wanted to mimic the pronunciation of "hero (ヒーロー)" more closely, they would have written it as "ひいろお" to include the longer "o" sound at the end. It also ties in with another interpretation we've seen going around which suggests that Shinta has been "lacking as a hero," so he’s missing the "お" at the end to fully spell out "ひいろお."

--

Episode 6 - The Red Mask

Okada Yu and the children are united once again after their challenge at the previous attraction. They develop a new strategy to use the medals to escape.

Looking back on their past hardships, Okada still decides to believe in them... but the Mai appears before him again—"I will help you remember." Okada chases after the girl who left those meaningful words. Meanwhile, Shinta forms the "Brave Squad" and sets off to explore Hero Theater A without telling Okada. However, Wataru, who usually gets along with Shinta, isn't too happy...

Okada is lured by the mysterious girl and the children challenge the new attraction without an "adult." The truth about Uropia is revealed to them at the end of their adventure...

--

About Maimaimaigoen

Maimaimaigoen is a multidimensional story about the "growing pains of the heart" of 16 children and their nursery school teachers. It examines each person as an individual and accompanies them through the difficulties of living in today's world.


Introduction

Okada Yu, a new nursery school teacher, is on a field trip to Sanrio Puroland with his students.  As they're about to head home after a fun day, his vision suddenly distorted... They wander into the mysterious amusement park Uropia where they're confronted by a strange yet oddly cute creature called "Froggy Egg." To escape from Uropia, he and the children must challenge the park's attractions and collect 10 medals...

--
